correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

N=18; O=np.ones((N,N),dtype=int); pix=list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(A==7))); top=(0,8); right=(8,17)
# Preserve 7s hit by either ray
ray7={(r,c) for r,c in pix if c==8 or r==8}
# Emit components in corners; partition by both ray axes
for rr in [0,1]:
 for cc in [0,1]:
  cells=[(r,c) for r,c in pix if ((r<8)==(rr==0)) and ((c<8)==(cc==0))]
  if not cells: continue
  rmin=min(r for r,c in cells); rmax=max(r for r,c in cells); cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
  # align to respective edges
  dr= -rmin if rr==0 else (17-rmax)
  dc= -cmin if cc==0 else (17-cmax)
  for r,c in cells: O[(r+dr)%N,(c+dc)%N]=7
# source ray 7s remain original
for r,c in ray7: O[r,c]=7
# beams
for r in range(0,12):
 if (r,8) not in ray7: O[r,8]=2
for c in range(4,18):
 if (8,c) not in ray7: O[8,c]=2
# marker 2s
O[0,8]=2; O[8,17]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in O))
